validation.legal: Default-root unchanged scanner, exact scoped snapshot; named-repository route invalid under workspace-hub issue3804

findings: MAJOR: Unattempted discriminator (attempt_consumed, native_attempt_count) sits outside the frozen ansys-evidence-1 schema. require_fields is a subset check (analysis_records.py:70) and execution_status enum (analysis_records.py:140) has no not-attempted value, so validate_package/load_package accept tampered or missing discriminators; only the entry point enforces them, and historical rows cannot be distinguished from unattempted ones. Remedy: optional typed attempt block or not_attempted enum validated in validate_case, absent = not recorded, and bump or document schema version.

MAJOR: Acceptance relies on unbundled artifacts: analysis_lookup.py gate behavior for not_applicable, r1 package/raw hashes, README contract and manifest layout. _validate_study accepts any disposition string and does not verify affected_responses reference real case/response pairs. Remedy: bundle lookup, manifest and README for exact-current review; add disposition enum and reference validation at build time.

MINOR: Revision publish and manifest os.replace run under separate lock acquisitions, allowing an interleaved writer; the .publish.lock is empty so the no-delete-other-owner rule makes crash-orphaned locks permanent. Remedy: lock content with owner/host/pid/time, single critical section for publish+manifest+CSV, defined stale-lock adjudication.

MINOR: Pending-case values for use_rights, author, author_status, capture_role, generated_at are unspecified, and parameter units have no typed field (parameters are name->decimal). Remedy: pin each value and the unit-in-key convention in the plan.

MINOR: No typed home for analytical comparators; any comparator stored in responses[].value appears in the CSV as a native decimal. Remedy: keep comparators in the criteria reference or a validated comparator field; test that no pending response is calculation_status=computed.

MINOR: read_response_csv uses json.loads without duplicate-key rejection and raises KeyError on missing 'response'; publish_package mkdirs before the residence check; a manifest copy in the revision directory double counts against the cumulative size limit. Remedy: reuse parse_json, check residence before mkdir, exclude manifest.json from the size glob or document it.

MAJOR: Pending rows record author=Codex with author_status=recorded. analysis_lookup.py _check_provenance refuses only author_status!=recorded or author in {unknown, unverified, historical-neutral-capture}, so pending rows clear the capture-author gate that all eight historical rows fail. The 'matrix preparation only' qualifier is prose-only; case IDs are stable and carry into later revisions. Remedy: validate_case must require author_status=unverified for capture_role=pending_native; record preparer in a separate input_descriptor field; test that engineering lookup refuses pending rows at the provenance gate.

MINOR: execution_status=unknown encodes a known fact (not attempted) and the derived CSV record_json carries only the response, so CSV consumers cannot see capture_role or attempt fields. Remedy: additive not_attempted enum required for pending_native (r1 stays valid), or at minimum a mandatory fixed limitation string such as native-not-attempted on every pending response.

MINOR: Package-level metadata refresh for r2 is unspecified: code_files/code_revision (analysis_records.py changes), method_revision, coverage counts, and the 17-candidate intake_reference that does not cover cylinder cases. Remedy: enumerate refreshed fields, keep native_captures=6, add pending-case count, and state how cylinder cases enter (intake revision or prepared benchmark manifest descriptor).

MINOR: A crash after immutable r2.json publication but before manifest refresh leads a retry using 'next unused revision' to publish a duplicate r3. Remedy: recovery locates and validates the highest published revision and resumes refresh idempotently; refuse publishing a revision whose case set and row hashes equal the latest; add a test.

MINOR: Outer integration lock must be O_EXCL in the dataset directory and must not use a .json suffix because publish_package sums *.json toward the 25 MB limit; README must document the r2 entry point, attempt-field semantics and revised stale-lock rule since it currently states the importer reproduces r1 only.

MAJOR: Package-level source_revision in the r2 candidate is stale (still r1 commit 9493f7b2...) while pending rows, code_files and the preparation record bind 5e7780f0...; build_pending_package never sets it. Remedy: builder must require/set the package-level source_revision (or record baseline_source_revision plus new), with a test that it differs from r1.

MAJOR: Frozen input identity is unpinned and self-referential: pending_inputs digests manifest.json from the bytes it just read and takes all other artifact digests from that manifest; the expected hash ea69920a... is never asserted as an input. Prepare script records git HEAD without a clean-tree check, so source_revision may not contain the bound bytes. Remedy: pass frozen manifest/reference digests into pending_inputs as required arguments, assert them in the prepare script, and refuse or record a dirty worktree.

MINOR: Ownership guarantee not enforced: _refresh calls _immutable(baseline, root) and materializes r1.json into any owner root lacking it (the fresh-root path is what the publish test exercises); nothing binds publication to the SOLVERS-2119-cli-final root. Remedy: require the baseline revision file to pre-exist at the given root or gate baseline creation behind an explicit flag.

MINOR: Plan r3 overclaims: promises 'explicit failed-refresh evidence' after manifest-then-CSV failure (code leaves only a stale CSV plus exception), says both 'explicit revision' and 'next unused revision' in item 3, and says lookup tests verify pending-row refusal but no such test is in the bundle. Remedy: correct plan text and add an engineering-mode lookup test on a pending row asserting refusal at the author-status gate.

MINOR: Pending responses carry inherited_findings=[] while historical rows list all 13; lookup unions the ledger so qualification is unaffected, but diagnostic answers copy the empty list, contradicting the plan's explicit-applicability claim. Remedy: populate wildcard-scoped findings on pending responses in the builder or document reliance on ledger union.

MINOR: analysis_matrix_publish._plain uses Path.is_junction (Python 3.12+ only; fails with AttributeError before locking on older runtimes) and the lock cleanup calls lock.read_bytes() in finally, which can mask the original refresh error. Remedy: document minimum Python or use guarded attribute lookup; wrap lock readback to preserve the original exception.

MAJOR | Candidate r2 provenance is self-inconsistent and not publishable as these bytes. Evidence: SOLVERS-PM-matrix-r2-candidate.json has source_revision=5e7780f0… while code_files binds analysis_pending.py dde52cec…, analysis_pending_inputs.py 4e5fe2af…, analysis_matrix_publish.py ea109b71…, analysis_records.py 17ebff0d… (baseline_code_files shows records.py was 06dce5eb… at r1). SOLVERS-PM-matrix-preparation.json records source_tree_dirty=true, but that record is external and not digest-bound into the package; the package itself carries no dirty-tree marker. README/plan promise reproducibility from the frozen source commit, yet the builder that produced r2 does not exist at 5e7780f0, so r2 cannot be regenerated from its own provenance fields. Remedy: commit the seven ansys modules, then rerun SOLVERS-PM-prepare-matrix.py (observation time is persisted, so generated_at is stable) and add `assert not dirty` before writing the candidate (or embed source_tree_state into the package). Re-review the regenerated candidate hash before any publish_matrix call.

MINOR | The added engineering-refusal test does not exercise pending-specific gates. Evidence: tests/ansys/test_analysis_pending.py::test_pending_lookup_remains_diagnostic_and_refuses_engineering calls lookup(package, query, resolver) with no authority/ledger, so it raises at analysis_lookup._check_authority ('current publication authority and ledger required') before _check_provenance/_qualify are reached. It would pass identically for a fully qualified row. Remedy: build a synthetic authority (revisions bound to package_hash, blocking_findings=False, criteria/review refs resolvable, empty ledger) and assert pytest.raises(ValueError, match='capture author is unknown') for the pending row, proving refusal originates from author_status/source_kind, not from missing authority.

MINOR | Pending rows publish inherited_findings=[] while the ledger declares '*'-scoped open findings. Evidence: analysis_pending_inputs._responses sets 'inherited_findings': [] for all 256 rows; finding_ledger entries broad-review-unresolved and unmapped-finding have affected_responses ['*'] and README states all inherited findings conservatively affect every response. Engineering lookup is safe because _check_provenance unions the ledger, but the diagnostic answer (lookup diagnostic=True returns the response copy) exposes an empty list to consumers and the historical rows list all 13 IDs. Remedy: populate pending rows with the '*'-scoped ledger IDs (or all 13, matching historical rows), or add an explicit limitation token such as 'ledger-findings-apply' so the data-level record is not read as finding-free.

MINOR | validate_attempt_state permits contradictory non-pending metadata. Evidence: analysis_records.validate_attempt_state returns after the consistency check for any capture_role other than pending_native, so a case with source_kind='native', execution_status='completed', attempt_consumed=False, native_attempt_count=0 validates and is not blocked by _qualify (which never reads attempt fields). test_shared_validator_accepts_consistent_nonpending_attempt_metadata only covers unverified/unknown cases. Remedy: when the pair is present, require native_attempt_count>=1 for execution_status in {'completed','failed'} and add a rehash-refusal test; leave absent-metadata historical rows untouched.

MINOR | Several refusal paths raise KeyError instead of ValueError, escaping the documented refusal contract. Evidence: analysis_matrix_publish._relation indexes package['previous_package_hash'] directly; analysis_pending_inputs.pending_inputs indexes manifest['artifacts'], manifest['reference'], manifest['case_order'], artifacts['prepared/basis-criteria.json'], entry['deck'], entry['metadata'] without require_fields. A malformed (but digest-pinned) manifest or a package lacking previous_package_hash fails with an unlabelled KeyError, which the operational wrapper described in context (retain exception as failed-refresh evidence) will record without a reason string. Remedy: use require_fields/nonempty with explicit ValueError messages ('successor package requires previous_package_hash', 'prepared manifest missing artifacts/reference/case_order') and add one negative test each.

MINOR | Resolver namespace and stranded-revision recovery are undocumented operational hazards. Evidence: SOLVERS-PM-prepare-matrix.py maps 'repository/…' IDs for r1 evidence to the content-addressed cache but pending_inputs maps 'repository/examples/ansys/cylinder-benchmark/…' to working-tree paths, then resolver.update(additional) overwrites on any collision; analysis_matrix_publish._refresh publishes the immutable r2 via _immutable before the final load_package(manifest)!=current recheck, so a nonparticipating manifest change after that point leaves r2.json published while every retry refuses ('canonical baseline changed'), with no documented recovery. Remedy: assert no key overlap when merging resolvers (raise on differing paths); add a README recovery note that a stranded immutable revision is retained and the canonical manifest must be restored to the r1 or r2 bytes before retrying, and that no new revision id is allocated.

MINOR | Pending generated_at predates the cited commit. Evidence: pending rows and SOLVERS-PM-matrix-preparation.json carry 2026-09-14T17:38:57.886592Z (persisted from the earlier dirty-tree run) while source_revision=806f4d8f… necessarily postdates that run; commit binding observed 17:52:58Z. Non-blocking because content is digest-bound. Remedy: keep the persisted value as inputs_observed_utc and add a separate preparation_utc in the preparation record, or document the semantics in the README.

MINOR | Regeneration inputs outside the repo are not digest-bound. Evidence: reproduction requires SOLVERS-PM-prepare-matrix.py (sha256 a74aea11…), SOLVERS-PM-matrix-observation.txt, SOLVERS-PM-matrix-resolver.json, the SOLVERS-2119-source-cache and deckhand-licensed-results tree; none are hashed in the preparation or commit-binding record. Remedy: record the prepare-script SHA256, observation file bytes, and resolver JSON SHA256 in SOLVERS-PM-matrix-commit-binding.json before publication.

MINOR | Pending solver descriptor is looser than the retained captures it will be compared against. Evidence: pending rows record only requested_release '2026 R1', cores 1, parallel smp, observed_native_version null; all six retained native captures record release '2026 R1.01', update UP20260202, build 26.1, argv '-b -np 1 -smp', equation_solver 'default sparse direct', and their note states stability comparison is valid only against a matching configuration. Remedy: pin build/update/argv/equation_solver in the pending solver block, or add an explicit limitation token that configuration matching is unverified until native capture.

MINOR | Ledger response-name mismatch inherited unchanged from r1. Evidence: finding_ledger entry original-padeye-force-channel lists 'padeye:equilibrium_residual_n' but the response is named force_residual_n; coverage is preserved by the 'padeye:*' wildcard and the row-level 'invalid-original-force-channel' limitation, so no bypass exists. Remedy: correct the ledger entry at the next revision that touches the ledger; not grounds to re-open r1.

MINOR | Prior 99b4ea MINOR items remain open and unchanged: empty inherited_findings on 256 pending rows versus '*'-scoped ledger entries; engineering-refusal test short-circuits at _check_authority; validate_attempt_state does not constrain non-pending attempt metadata; KeyError refusal paths in analysis_matrix_publish._relation and analysis_pending_inputs.pending_inputs; resolver.update collision and stranded-immutable-revision recovery undocumented.
